timingMeaning: Measured CPU-side renderer/visual wall time; includes submission and driver waits, not GPU execution time. Parallel visual tasks can overlap; their summed work is not elapsed frame latency.
geometryMeaning: Observed BufferBuilder vertices and estimated vertex data; alternative rendering pipelines may bypass these counters. Not GPU uploads or VRAM.
coverageMeaning: Standard individual entity preparation and entity/block entity renderer calls. Terrain, particles, GUI and third-party instanced/deferred paths are not attributed by this adapter; totals are not the complete cost of a mod.
gpuMeaning: CPU timers do not measure GPU execution. This adapter does not collect per-object GPU timing.
percentiles: Capture percentiles use bounded histograms; averages include frames with zero calls.

integrations.coverage: Ordinary renderer timing remains active; native vertex-copy ABI has not been inspected
Shadow pass excluded from ordinary object and shared Flywheel measurements; shader buffer override ABI has not been inspected

limitations: Terrain/chunk batches are not attributed to individual mods or world objects.
Vertex estimates may omit this renderer's native fast paths; use Timing Only when required.
Shader execution and terrain GPU cost are not distributed among mods or individual objects.
